spec.description: Sends a single, new order into the exchange. A range of order types, Time-In-Force (TIF) settings and order flags can be specified. For triggered order types (`stop-loss`, `take-profit`, `trailing-stop`), `triggers` carries the price-tracking and trigger-threshold parameters. For One-Triggers-Other (OTO) orders, `conditional` carries the parameters for a secondary close order attached to the primary order.

anyOf.title: WsAddOrderMarket
anyOf.description: A market order: executes immediately at the best available price.

order_type.description: The execution model of the order.

order_qty.description: Order quantity in terms of the base asset.

symbol.description: The symbol of the currency pair, e.g. `BTC/USD`.

time_in_force.description: How long the order remains in effect before expiring: `gtc` (Good Till Canceled), `gtd` (Good Till Date -- until `expire_time`), `ioc` (Immediate Or Cancel -- cancels any unfilled remainder on arrival), or `fok` (Fill Or Kill -- fills the full quantity or cancels entirely; `limit` orders only).

margin.description: Funds the order on margin using the maximum leverage for the pair (max leverage of 5).

post_only.description: Cancels the order if it would take liquidity on arrival; post-only orders are always posted passively in the book. Only for orders with a limit price.

reduce_only.description: Reduces an existing margin position without opening an opposite position worth more than the current value of the leveraged assets.

effective_time.description: Scheduled start time, RFC3339, precision to seconds.

expire_time.description: Expiration time of the order, RFC3339, precision to seconds. GTD orders can expire up to one month in the future.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp, millisecond precision. Valid offsets from the current time range from 500ms to 60s (default 5s). The engine will not match this order after this time -- protection against latency on time-sensitive orders.

cl_ord_id.description: Alphanumeric client order identifier uniquely identifying an open order for this client. Mutually exclusive with `order_userref`. One of: a long UUID (32 hex chars, dashed), a short UUID (32 hex chars, no dashes), or free text up to 18 ASCII characters.

order_userref.description: Optional non-unique numeric identifier associable with any number of orders by the client (e.g. a timestamp). Not enforced unique by Kraken, so it can also group orders by pair/side/strategy for querying or cancelling. Mutually exclusive with `cl_ord_id`.

fee_preference.description: Fee preference, base or quote currency. `quote` is the default for buy orders, `base` is the default for sell orders.

no_mpp.description: Deprecated -- if supplied, accepted but ignored. Was: disable Market Price Protection (which protects market orders from filling at a bad price during slippage) for market orders.

stp_type.description: Self Trade Prevention mode, protecting against inadvertently trading against oneself: `cancel_newest` (cancel the arriving order), `cancel_oldest` (cancel the resting order), or `cancel_both`.

validate.description: If `true`, the order is validated only -- it never reaches the matching engine and no `order_id` is returned.

sender_sub_id.description: Alphanumeric sub-account/trader identifier enabling Self Trade Prevention at a more granular level, for institutional accounts with enhanced STP. Same three accepted formats as `cl_ord_id`.

stop_price.description: Deprecated -- use the `triggers` object. Stop price for trigger order types.

trigger.description: Deprecated -- use `triggers.reference`. Reference price to trigger the order, for triggered order types only.

cash_order_qty.description: Order volume expressed in the quote currency. For buy market orders without margin funding.

deadline.description: RFC3339 timestamp, millisecond precision. Valid offsets from the current time range from 500ms to 60s (default 5s). The engine will not match this order after this time -- protection against latency on time-sensitive orders.

cl_ord_id.description: Alphanumeric client order identifier uniquely identifying an open order for this client. Mutually exclusive with `order_userref`. One of: a long UUID (32 hex chars, dashed), a short UUID (32 hex chars, no dashes), or free text up to 18 ASCII characters.

order_userref.description: Optional non-unique numeric identifier associable with any number of orders by the client (e.g. a timestamp). Not enforced unique by Kraken, so it can also group orders by pair/side/strategy for querying or cancelling. Mutually exclusive with `cl_ord_id`.

fee_preference.description: Fee preference, base or quote currency. `quote` is the default for buy orders, `base` is the default for sell orders.

no_mpp.description: Deprecated -- if supplied, accepted but ignored. Was: disable Market Price Protection (which protects market orders from filling at a bad price during slippage) for market orders.

stp_type.description: Self Trade Prevention mode, protecting against inadvertently trading against oneself: `cancel_newest` (cancel the arriving order), `cancel_oldest` (cancel the resting order), or `cancel_both`.

validate.description: If `true`, the order is validated only -- it never reaches the matching engine and no `order_id` is returned.

sender_sub_id.description: Alphanumeric sub-account/trader identifier enabling Self Trade Prevention at a more granular level, for institutional accounts with enhanced STP. Same three accepted formats as `cl_ord_id`.

stop_price.description: Deprecated -- use the `triggers` object. Stop price for trigger order types.

trigger.description: Deprecated -- use `triggers.reference`. Reference price to trigger the order, for triggered order types only.

order_id.description: Unique order identifier generated by Kraken. Absent when `validate=true`, since no order actually reaches the matching engine.

cl_ord_id.description: The client identifier specified in the request `params`, if any.

order_userref.description: The client identifier specified in the request `params`, if any.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the order, if any.

notes: `token` (the auth bearer token) is documented by Kraken as a required params field but is deliberately absent from this schema: `core/transport/ws.py`'s `SocketConnection.rpc_send` merges the cached token into every outgoing `params` on the private connection -- trading calls and subscribe/unsubscribe alike -- so it is transport-injected, never a caller-supplied argument, the same way `req_id` (the declared `correlate` field) never appears in a requestBody schema. This endpoint's parameter surface is the full documented one -- clients/kraken/pkg/src/kraken/trading_ws/add_order.py's hand-written `add_order` currently only wires `symbol`/`side`/`order_type`/`order_qty`/`limit_price`/`validate`, deliberately partial per core.md's Gotchas (full coverage was left to codegen); this spec is that full coverage. Deprecated-but-still-documented fields (`no_mpp`, `stop_price`, `trigger`, `conditional.stop_price`) are kept per rule 7 and marked `"deprecated": true` rather than dropped.
